site_name: Site south west junction of Glenworth Avenue and Saunders Ness Road, E14 3EB
description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/15/00360 permitted 18/12/2015.It is proposed to amend condition 19 to alter the operating hours for the school to accommodate the union agreement of a 35hr working week, whilst maintaining the purpose of the condition.Condition 19: 'The teaching hours of the school hereby permitted shall start no later than 8.30am and finish no earlier than 3.55pm."It is proposed to amend condition 19 as follows: 'The teaching hours of the school hereby permitted shall start no later than 8.15am and finish no earlier than 3.00pm.Reason: To stagger the teaching hours of the new school with those of St Luke's Primary School to avoid congestion on the public highway and ensure the amenity of nearby residents is not compromised, in accordance with Tower Hamlets Core Strategy 2010 Policy SP09 and Policy DM20 of the Managing Development Document 2013"
